title: fix(fields): give the file grid cell a view/download affordance (objectui#9485)
body:
Fixes #9485

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`FileCell` in `packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx` — the compact `file` control a
line-item grid row draws — rendered each stored file as a chip of image thumbnail or file
icon, the filename, and a delete button. There was **no ANCHOR element anywhere inside that
chip**, so an attachment sitting on a grid row (delivery-note lines, material certificates)
could not be opened or downloaded.

The chip's bare name now renders `FileValueAffordance` — the shared component objectui#9161
landed for the other `file` surfaces — with `icon` set to false, because the chip already
draws its own thumbnail or file icon immediately to its left. Everything else in the chip is
untouched: the thumbnail, the file icon, and the delete button while editable.

⚠️ **`disabled` is the worse half, and that is why this is not cosmetic.** `disabled` is this
control's read-only state: it draws no picker button and no delete button either, so the chip
was *nothing but* a filename and no route to the file existed at all. Every pin below runs in
both states, and the `disabled` ones additionally COUNT the buttons — zero — which is what
makes the anchor the entire affordance there rather than one of several.

**No new module, endpoint, authoring switch or translation key.** The shared component was
already imported into this very file by objectui#9161, two call sites above the defect, and
the URL was already in hand: `readFileValues` resolves the expanded value's own `url`, or
derives the stable `/api/v1/storage/files/:id` endpoint from a bare `sys_file` id, which
302-redirects to a freshly-signed short-lived URL per request. The link text is the file name,
so it is the anchor's accessible name and nothing new had to be translated; a value carrying
no name of its own still falls back to the existing `fields.file.fileFallback` key.

⛔ **A value that resolves to no URL still renders as plain TEXT, never a dead anchor** —
objectui#8490's ruling for `email` / `url` / `phone`, applied to this family. That case is
pinned green on BOTH sides of this change, which is what proves the fallback rather than the
happy path.

⛔ Not a duplicate of objectui#9161 and it is not reopened here: that card's dispatch named the
`readonly` branch and the edit-state file rows, and `FileCell` is the third component in this
widget file, left outside that file surface on purpose. Nothing upstream of the rendering is
touched — the storage path was already healthy.

## The pin is the first actual measurement of this surface

The card was filed from a source reading and says so in its own words: the filer states they
did not reproduce it in a browser. `packages/fields/src/__tests__/fileCellDownload-9485.test.tsx`
therefore renders the component and reads its DOM — never a helper's return value, never source
text, either of which would pass on a component that does not render what the helper returns.

`getByRole('link', { name })` is deliberate over a `querySelector`: it asserts in one call that
the affordance is in the accessibility tree as a link (an anchor with no `href` is not, so no
keyboard reaches it) and that its accessible name is the file name.

### Reverse verification — measured, and restored under a trap

The fix was committed FIRST. Then `packages/fields/src/widgets/FileField.tsx` alone was
restored to the branch point `4598f6d29`, with the pin file left untouched. The mutation was
proved to have landed on disk by blob hash before the run (`c5c54e0f`, equal to the branch
point's blob and different from HEAD's `36952b78`), and the restore was proved afterwards by
blob hash plus an empty `git diff HEAD` for that path. The whole sequence ran under a
`trap RESTORE EXIT INT TERM` with absolute paths.

| tree | vitest exit | result |
|---|---|---|
| pre-fix (that one file at `4598f6d29`, pin untouched) | 1 | 13 failed, 3 passed (16) |
| post-fix (this branch) | 0 | 16 passed (16) |

The two headline reds the card asks for, from the pre-fix run:

- `THE DEFECT — enabled: the chip's bare name becomes a link with a real href` — RED,
  `TestingLibraryElementError: Unable to find an accessible element with the role "link" and name "delivery-note.pdf"`
- `THE DEFECT — disabled (the read-only state): the chip's bare name becomes a link with a real href` — RED, same message

The negative case is green on both sides, in three pins:

- `⛔ NEVER a dead anchor — enabled: an unresolvable value stays plain TEXT` — GREEN pre-fix and post-fix
- `⛔ NEVER a dead anchor — disabled (the read-only state): an unresolvable value stays plain TEXT` — GREEN pre-fix and post-fix
- `⛔ and when nothing resolves, `disabled` is text with no controls and no anchor` — GREEN pre-fix and post-fix

Those three were the ONLY pre-fix greens, so the pin is not passing for an incidental reason.

ESLint was run targeted rather than repo-wide, and the narrowing is declared: `pnpm lint`

file it does not contain. ⚠️ The one piece of evidence NOT taken is the repo-wide population
count: eslint's own file total was not enumerated, so read the targeted run as a targeted run.

## Clause-②: `no`, counted off this diff

`FileCell`'s signature does not move; what moves is what it renders. Counted off the pushed
diff against the branch point rather than inherited: `git diff 4598f6d29..HEAD | grep -c
'^+export'` is **0**, with a lit control of **300** added lines total so the pattern class is
demonstrably live, and the broader `grep -E '^\+.*\bexport\b'` finds **0** as well — no
export appears anywhere in the added lines, not merely at line start.

⚠️ Named rather than hidden: this neighbourhood IS on the published face — `FileCell` is
re-exported through `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`'s barrel, so the usual "not in the entry"
shortcut does not apply. The `no` rests on no signature and no declarable key moving.

## Acceptance notes

Noted while in this file, deliberately NOT filed and NOT fixed here:

- The `FileCell` picker button takes its accessible name only from the `aria-label` its host
  passes; with a file already present it renders no text, so a host that passes none leaves the
  button unnamed. Pre-existing, unrelated to this card, and not one of the three filing classes
  — it is an observation, not a reproduced defect. Who will meet it: whoever next dispatches the
  `GridField` cell-accessibility sweep. If nobody does, successor: none.
- The chip's wrapper SPAN and the anchor now both carry a `title` of the file name. Harmless
  nesting, matches the landed sibling's shape, cosmetic. Successor: none.

Neither is an error, a declared-contract breach, or a trap that makes a writer emit metadata the
runtime rejects, so neither is filed.
